messages:
jane-cust: hitting 429s + 2-5s tail latency on our Dedicated pool in na-west2 since ~05:10 UTC. customer says requests timeout then get retried.

alice-support: thanks @jane-cust — opening incident thread. Can you paste the failing request id(s)?

jane-cust: req ids: req_8a1f, req_8a20. They show status=429, body='quota_exceeded' then a bunch of 503s for a minute.

ben-sre: seeing spike in placement failures for dedicated-na-west2 at 05:09:45. Autoscaler repeatedly tried to spin new nodes and got throttled by hypervisor quota. Logs: `placement: deny code=RATE_LIMIT region=na-west2 reason=alloc_quota`.

carla-infra: confirming — cloud provider returned 429 on instance create; our reserved burst pool was empty. Autoscale loop retried every 6s, hit provider-side rate limit, and timed out so requests queued -> queue depth ~230.

ben-sre: repro steps I ran: curl to our placement API -> returned 503, sample: ```{"error":"placement_failed","details":"no available gpus in az-3"}```. Also saw KV cache warmups pushed more load.

alice-support: customer is asking for immediate mitigation: can we reroute their workload to other regions/alternative pool? They rely on low latency so cross-region adds latency but beats 429s.

david-eng: quick mitigation options: 1) reroute their org to na-central dedicated pool (same account) — needs config flip in routing rules; 2) apply emergency burst capacity reserved pool for their tenant if available; 3) enable temporary fallback to hosted API (same model) with a warning about data path. I can do (1) if infra gives green.

carla-infra: we have limited spare capacity in na-central and eu-west1. Reroute requires adding a routing override: `PATCH /routing/v1/overrides/{org}` with body `{ "preferred_regions": ["na-central"] }`. I can apply after a quick risk check.

ben-sre: before reroute, recommend throttling back non-critical tenants in na-west2 to free slots — noisy neighbor suspected. I can run `queries.top-tenants --region na-west2 --metric allocs` and mark top 3 for backpressure.

alice-support: jane, want to check if you accept na-central fallback for next 2 hours? We'll monitor latency and roll you back when na-west2 recovers.

jane-cust: ok do it. prefer na-central. Also can you share repro steps so we can validate?

ben-sre: repro steps for internal teams and customer: 1) Send a single high-QPS job to dedicated pool and observe placement 2) If placement returns placement_failed with code RATE_LIMIT, run `GET /placement/v1/allocs?region=na-west2` to inspect queue depth and `GET /autoscale/v1/activities` to see retries. 3) Collect `placement.log` lines around the timestamp and paste.

carla-infra: applying routing override now for org=org-422: `PATCH /routing/v1/overrides/org-422` -> response 200. Pushed to control plane, routing caches will propagate in ~18s.

autoscale-bot: routing override applied by carla-infra for org-422; old routes invalidated.

david-eng: monitoring latency after switch. Initial traffic shows 200s instead of 429s, p99 tail latency up ~30ms due to cross-region, but overall success rate restored.

alice-support: communicating to customer: routed to na-central, success restored. We're continuing to monitor and working with infra to request more burst capacity from provider.

ben-sre: follow-ups: - escalate to cloud accounts to request quota/burst increase for na-west2 - investigate noisy tenant throttling heuristics to auto-throttle top allocators - improve autoscaler backoff to avoid rapid retry storms. I'll open tracking PRs.

jane-cust: thanks team — will validate on our side and report anything odd. Appreciate the quick fix :thumbsup:

alice-support: closing loop here once provider confirms quota increase. Adding postmortem tag for long-term fixes.
